candidates.requirement: Exercise parser_free with an unattached saved comment after a parse error.
candidates.target_route: Create a parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS, parse /*x*/}, then free the parser after the error.
candidates.failure_condition: The old target creates the parser with flags 0 and returns on error before calling parser_free, so no input exercises the new last_comment cleanup.
candidates.alternative_paths: Successful parses attach a pending comment before cleanup; the target has no other parser setup or free call.

candidates.requirement: Release each created parser when parsing reports an error.
candidates.target_route: Supply the one-byte input {; add_string reaches the UCL state machine, which reports an unmatched opening brace; get_error is non-NULL.
candidates.failure_condition: The target returns on a non-NULL error without calling parser_free, leaving the parser allocated.
candidates.alternative_paths: The only parser_free call follows the error return; there is no cleanup on that branch.

before.requirement: Exercise release of an unattached saved comment in parser_free.
before.reason: The before-version parser_free has no release of last_comment, so this specific changed behavior did not yet exist.

after.requirement: Exercise parser_free with an unattached saved comment after a parse error.
after.reason: The new release is conditional on last_comment. The unchanged harness uses flags 0 and returns before parser_free on an error.

claims.reason: The release operation was added in g0002. The old target’s fixed flags and error return prevent it from running after the change.

before.requirement: Free the parser created for an input that produces a parse error.
before.reason: The one-byte input { produces an unmatched-brace error on the before source, and the harness returns before its only parser_free call.

after.requirement: Free the parser created for the same input when it produces the same parse error.
after.reason: The unmatched-brace error and the harness’s early return remain; the added comment cleanup does not free a parser when parser_free is never called.

claims.reason: The same input, parser allocation, parse error and early return leave the parser unreleased on both versions.
